resources.name: Alarm
resources.description: Base entity schema for use in TMForum Open-APIs. Property.

fields.name: externalAlarmId
fields.description: An identifier of the alarm in the source system.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Defines the alarm state during its life cycle (raised, updated, cleared).

fields.name: alarmType
fields.description: Categorizes the alarm (X.733 8.1.1, 3GPP TS 32.111-2 Annex A)

fields.name: perceivedSeverity
fields.description:
Lists the possible severities that can be allocated to an Alarm. The values are consistent with ITU-T Recommendation X.733.
Once an alarm has been cleared, its perceived severity is set to 'cleared' and can no longer be set.

fields.name: probableCause
fields.description: Provides the probable cause of the alarm. The values are consistent with ITU-T Recommendation X.733 or 3GPP TS 32.111-2 Annex B.

fields.name: specificProblem
fields.description: Provides more specific information about the alarm.

fields.name: alarmedObjectType
fields.description: The type (class) of the managed object associated with the event.

fields.name: reportingSystemId
fields.description: Reporting system identity.

fields.name: sourceSystemId
fields.description: Source system identity.

fields.name: alarmDetails
fields.description: Contains further information on the alarm.

fields.name: alarmRaisedTime
fields.description: Indicates the time (as a date + time) at which the alarm occurred at its source.

fields.name: alarmChangedTime
fields.description: Indicates the last date and time when the alarm is changed on the alarm-owning system. Any change to the alarm whether coming from the alarmed resource, or triggered by a change from the client is changing this time.

fields.name: alarmClearedTime
fields.description: Indicates the time (as a date + time) at which the alarm is cleared at the source.

fields.name: alarmReportingTime
fields.description:
Indicates the time (as a date + time) at which the alarm was reported by the owning OSS. It might be different from the alarmRaisedTime. For instance, if the alarm list is maintained by an EMS, the alarmRaisedtime would be the time the alarm
  was detected by the NE, while the alarmReportingTime would be the time this alarm was stored in the alarm list of the EMS.

fields.name: ackState
fields.description: Provides the Acknowledgement State of the alarm (unacknowledged, acknowledged).

fields.name: ackSystemId
fields.description: Provides the name of the system that last changed the ackState of an alarm, i.e. acknowledged or unacknowledged the alarm.

fields.name: ackUserId
fields.description: Provides the id of the user who has last changed the ack state of the alarm, i.e. acknowledged or unacknowledged the alarm.

fields.name: alarmEscalation
fields.description: Indicates if this alarm has been escalated or not.

fields.name: clearSystemId
fields.description: Provides the id of the system where the user who invoked the alarmCleared operation is located.

fields.name: clearUserId
fields.description: Provides the id of the user who invoked the alarmCleared operation

fields.name: isRootCause
fields.description: Indicates whether the alarm is a root cause alarm..

fields.name: plannedOutageIndicator
fields.description: Indicates that the Managed Object (related to this alarm) is in planned outage (in planned maintenance, or out-of-service).

fields.name: proposedRepairedActions
fields.description: Indicates proposed repair actions, if known to the system emitting the alarm.

fields.name: serviceAffecting
fields.description: Indicates whether the alarm affects service or not.

fields.name: referredType
fields.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation.

fields.name: href
fields.description: The URI of the referred entity.

fields.name: refId

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the referred entity.
